name: Fino Inc.
summary: Fino Inc. operates as an information and communication, and game development company in South Korea and internationally. The company offers communication equipment, including repeaters and electrical communication installations. It also develops Dragon Raja2 and The Croods Battle Adventure games. The company was formerly known as Skymoons technology, Inc. and changed its name to Fino Inc. in August 2024. Fino Inc. was founded in 1990 and is based in Anyang-si, South Korea.
